content:
maria: Quick sync — I want to design a small benchmark harness to directly compare synthetic load vs replay traces to validate kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV-cache warmup behavior. Also need to quantify quality/perf tradeoffs for quant profiles and speculative decoding.

maria: Proposed minimal plan:
- replay 10M tokens from prod traces (anonymized)
- synthetic stories with controlled seq-len dist + branching
- measure p50/p95 latency, throughput, tail, and T/s
- trace kernel_id per op and kernel-switch counts
- record KV cache hit/miss over time and batch size distribution
Thoughts?

tj: SGTM. keep seeds & prompts deterministic. For replay, run a converter that strips user metadata and normalizes tokens. Do we have a converter script?

sasha: I can add lightweight tracepoints (kernel_id, batch_size, time_ns) on forward path. Also will emit a per-request KV_hit boolean so we can build hit-ratio curves.

liam: For quant reg gate, propose: fail if eval-quality delta > 0.5% (top-1/ROUGE or user eval metric) or perplexity delta > 0.7. Run each quant profile 3x and use median.

maria: + ROI metric: wall_time_per_1k_tokens / estimated infra_cost. We want to see cost reductions vs quality loss.

perf-bot: baseline-run: float32 baseline completed. p50=48ms p95=190ms throughput=2400 tps. artifacts: https://ci/redwood/runs/17555

tj: For speculative decoding: capture accept_rate and rollback_cost. Use synthetic branching prompts to stress misprediction. Measure additional latency when rollback happens (and token waste).

sasha: KV warmup protocol proposal:
1) cold-start (empty KV)
2) 1k repeated prefixes warmup
3) mixed live-style trace
Record KV_hit_ratio over windows of 1000 requests.

maria: We'll also sample opcounts and kernel-switch heatmaps every 10s. Important: apples-to-apples -> pin hardware, driver version, cuda/cuDNN/cutlass, and batcher config.

liam: And pin model checkpoint + disable on-the-fly JIT to avoid non-determinism.

maria: I'll push a draft YAML for the harness. Example:
```
runner:
  mode: replay
  trace_path: s3://redwood-traces/replay-10M.json
  pin_hardware: ampere-1
  kernels_trace: true
quant_profiles:
  - int8-q4
  - int8-q8
speculative:
  enabled: true
  max_rollbacks: 2
```

maria: Next steps: sasha adds tracepoints, I'll wire harness and a comparison notebook showing p50/p95, kernel-switch matrix, KV curves, and quant-qual curves. tj will add synthetic story generator. liam will finalize regression gate thresholds.

tj: I'll start on generator. Will reuse existing replay-converter for token normalization.

sasha: Will PR tracepoints today. Expect small perf overhead (~0.5%); will validate.

liam: If perf overhead too high, switch to sampled tracing (1% of requests) then extrapolate.

maria: Great. sync tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
